versions.changelog:
personwise-product-change-adoption v2.1.9

- Clarified that requests for other course types require explicit user initiation with this Skill.
- Updated instructions for CLI usage: the default is now to use the declared market-bound PersonWise release, but explicit user choice of another official market release is now honored.
- Adjusted attribution section to increment version number in sample JSON output.
- Added the Bash tool to allowed-tools and permissions.
- Removed outdated file (skill-card.md) and cleaned up workflow description and approvals language for clarity and user consent.
- Minor updates for precision in how approvals and updates are managed.

personwise-product-change-adoption v2.1.8

- Clarified skill triggers and scope: only for specific product change adoption; ordinary course creation uses the same workflow but isn’t a trigger in itself.
- Tightened evidence-locking: all presented content must be grounded in supplied materials; flagged policy for unclear deadlines and unsupported promises.
- Expanded CLI and update management instructions, detailing precise version checks, upgrade flows, and session handling for CLI and Skill updates.
- Added new, detailed workflow steps for course authorization and automation, emphasizing safety and deterministic update handling.
- Updated attribution instructions, specifying required JSON block when skill attribution is supported.
